bullets.text: Crypto Travel Rule Enforced — The UK has implemented the Crypto Travel Rule, requiring Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs) to collect and share customer information for transactions, enhancing financial crime prevention.
AI Governance Evolving — Singapore's Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is shifting towards evidence-based AI governance, urging financial institutions to prepare for stricter compliance by 2026.
EU Supervisory Reporting Reform — The European Banking Authority (EBA) is simplifying supervisory reporting to reduce costs and improve efficiency, with new requirements expected by September 2027.
CDO Role Transformation — Chief Data Officers (CDOs) must now demonstrate the commercial and operational value of data, shifting focus from management to measurable business impact.
FCA's AI Review Impact — The FCA's Mills Review indicates a significant shift towards AI in wealth management, urging firms to adapt to consumer preferences for AI-driven financial services.
